data.one_liner: Flutter widget for rendering QR codes with customizable size, colors, and optional embedded images.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget (QrImageView) that generates QR code graphics on the fly using the Dart QR library. It supports version auto‑detection, error correction levels, styling of eyes and data modules, and can overlay an image in the centre. No network connection is required.
use_when: You need to display QR codes inside a Flutter UI
You want custom styling (colors, padding, embedded logo) without external services
avoid_when: You need to scan QR codes (use a scanner package)
You require server‑side QR generation or batch image files
strengths: Null‑safe and works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Only generates QR codes, no scanning capability
No built‑in caching or image export beyond raw data

alternatives.name: pretty_qr_code
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar QR code rendering with additional styling options and can be a drop‑in replacement for simple QR display needs
